biggestRisk: The plan names the global, first-come `grownup` role as 'the biggest decision', then leaves it open. Its child-management functions (createChild, listChildren, resetChildPassword, deleteChild) still run on `role:grownup`, and step 1 reuses the auto-claiming Pages/Grownups sign-in. So only one family per backend can ever have a grown-up, that parent also becomes the content admin for GameChange, `signup:public` stays open, and an anonymous child device cannot call `listChildren` to show its name picker.
